explication: ILSpy is a cross-platform .NET assembly browser and decompiler. The principal workflow is: a user opens an assembly, the desktop frontend organizes it into assembly lists, the decompiler reads metadata and produces C# or project output, and the UI presents navigable results. Sampled code also shows BAML/XAML handling, comparison, bookmarks, themes, command requerying, and PowerShell access. Several frontend and engine links are inferred from documented capabilities because their orchestrating source was not sampled.
